As an orbital welding operator, you will work with various advanced welding processes and contribute to the production of high-quality stainless steel assemblies. Based on technical drawings and production planning, you will independently carry out work orders while ensuring precision and quality throughout the entire process.

In this role, you will prepare and process components, perform orbital and TIG welding activities, and work with technologies such as laser welding and laser marking. You will manufacture and assemble stainless steel hoses, couplings, bends, and other complex components using orbital welding heads, welding robots, and manual manipulators.

You will also be responsible for performing helium leak tests and final quality inspections to ensure all products meet the highest industry standards. In addition, you will set up and adjust machines when required and carry out first-line maintenance to support a smooth and efficient production process.

Besides the hands-on technical work, you will complete work orders digitally within the system and contribute to the development and improvement of new products and production methods. Sharing technical knowledge with colleagues and supporting team members where needed is also an important part of the role.

This is a specialized position where craftsmanship, technical expertise, precision, and quality come together within a modern high-tech production environment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Minimum mbo level 2 technical education or proven experience in metalworking
- Experience with orbital welding is a plus

Each day starts with a short meeting to go over tasks and priorities so everyone knows what to do.

In this job, you pick pallets and orders quickly and accurately to meet daily targets. You also keep stock levels correct by refilling shelves. Scanning and preparing orders is part of your routine, making sure everything is correct and ready for shipping.

You keep the warehouse organized, safe, and easy to work in. Sometimes you also help with other tasks, like case picking or working with Kardex cabinets and Flow Racks.

This job is flexible: you will work rotating shifts from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM and 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM on alternating weeks.

- A valid reach truck certificate
- Digital skills: experience with ASTRO WMS is a plus, but general computer proficiency is sufficient
- Proficiency in English; Dutch is a plus but not required
- Flexibility to work rotating shifts from 7:00‑16:00 and 10:00‑19:00 (alternating weeks)

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

- Identifying and reporting deviations or technical issues

Technical education and/or technical work experience

Availability for a 2-shift schedule

Are you interested?
Apply directly via the application button.

Every item is checked, sorted and registered, so it can be sold again quickly. As supervisor, you lead the team that does this work. You divide the work, monitor the quality and make sure returns are processed on time. You are at the heart of the team and the point of contact for your colleagues and for the other departments. 
 About Hartevelt 
Hartevelt Fashion Fulfilment is a family business that started in 1945 as a dry cleaner in Zeist. Four generations later, we are a full service fulfilment partner for fashion brands. From our warehouse of more than 21,000 m² in De Meern, we handle the complete logistics process: goods receipt, order processing, packing, returns, reconditioning and cleaning. Our clients ship anywhere from a few thousand to more than a million orders a year. What sets us apart is that we offer everything under one roof, with the commitment of a family business.
